name: LANDMRK
recent: Landmarks Berhad 近期推进一项以发行新股支付、价值 RM4.48 million 的收购，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交新股上市申请。公司同时出现多项董事、首席人员及公司秘书变动，并因触发 Rule 8.03A 而持续发布月度公告。最新季度仍录得亏损，营收同比下滑。
notable: 拟以发行新股方式，以 RM4.48 million 收购 Mendol Investments Pte Ltd 的 5.10% 股权。
已就上述收购的代价股份向 Bursa Securities 提交上市及报价申请。
2026 年 10 月出现董事、首席人员及公司秘书的一系列人事变动。
risks: 收购代价以发行新股支付，可能带来股权摊薄。
公司因 Paragraph/Rule 8.03A 持续发布月度公告。
最新季度净亏损 RM4.612 million，营收同比下滑 23.6%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM4.31 million，环比增长 11.8%，但同比下滑 23.6%；净亏损为 RM4.612 million，净亏损率为 107.0%，较上一季度的 149.2% 有所收窄。

recent_en: Landmarks Berhad is proceeding with a RM4.48 million acquisition of a 5.10% stake in Mendol Investments, to be satisfied via new shares, and has submitted the listing application to Bursa Securities. The company also saw several changes in directors, principal officer and company secretaries, while continuing monthly announcements under Rule 8.03A. Its latest quarter remained loss-making with revenue lower year-on-year.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of a 5.10% equity interest in Mendol Investments Pte Ltd for RM4.48 million, to be satisfied via issuance of new Landmarks shares.
Listing and quotation application for the consideration shares for the proposed acquisition has been submitted to Bursa Securities.
A series of changes in directors, principal officer and company secretaries occurred in October 2026.
risks_en: The acquisition consideration is to be satisfied via new share issuance, which may result in equity dilution.
The company continues to issue monthly announcements under Paragraph/Rule 8.03A.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM4.612 million with revenue down 23.6% year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM4.31 million, up 11.8% quarter-on-quarter but down 23.6% year-on-year; net loss was RM4.612 million with a net margin of -107.0%, narrower than -149.2% in the previous quarter.
